thread:
maria.finance: Heads up — we spotted a reconciliation gap for the March cutover of the Embedding Promo (trial credits converted to paid after 03/01). Hosted API reported 120k embed units, billing shows 90k, variance ~30k. Does this get booked as a month-end accrual or a deferred revenue adjustment?
ben.billing: thanks Maria. quick q: are the 30k units from trial-to-paid conversion (in-account credits) or from a ratecard change? if credits were consumed, we should zero out revenue and record contra-revenue if invoiced incorrectly.
irene.revrec: tagging revrec rules: we need to normalize to consistent UOM before recognition. For month-end close, book an accrual for the estimated 30k * price_per_unit, and then run a post-close adjustment once billing export is corrected and final invoice numbers available. Approve?
maria.finance: it's a combo. Marketing pushed a promo that auto-credited trial accounts 10k units on 02/25; system change on 03/01 changed granularity of embed units (old unit=10 vectors, new unit=1 vector) — so numbers don't align. Billing exported using old unit until 03/02.
irene.revrec: we need to capture the economic substance: credits consumed = no revenue; paid conversions = revenue when invoiced/earned. since export mismatch, we either estimate or wait for corrected export. for close risk, recommend accrual.
devon-ops: FYI logs show billing-export job v2 failed to pick up unit_scale flag on 03/01 due to a migration race. Fix merged, will re-run export now. Expect corrected file in ~20m.
ben.billing: ok if ops re-runs and we get final export today, we can avoid accrual. if not, we'll accrue and reverse next period. need sign-off from RevRec (Irene) and Accounting (Maria).
irene.revrec: approved to accrue if corrected export not received by 6pm PT today. Use estimate method: prorate by known account-level credits. Code snippet for JE:
irene.revrec: ```
DR Accounts Receivable - Hosted API  $X
CR Deferred Revenue - Embedding Promo $X
(Accrual for estimated unbilled embed usage due to unit-scale mismatch)
```
maria.finance: noted. maria.finance added action items: 1) devon re-run export and drop file in s3://company-finance/exports/mar-cutover.csv 2) ben to re-run recon script reconcile_embeddings.py 3) if corrected not available by 6pm PT, AP to post accrual JE as per Irene. @devon please confirm ETA :clock3: 
devon-ops: re-run kicked off, ETA 12min. will ping when done. :white_check_mark:
acct-bot: reminder: once JE posted use journal id prefix 'ACR-EMB-2391' and include notes 'unit-scale cutover accrual — estimate; reverse on final invoice'.
maria.finance: thanks all — I'll hold posting until we have file. will update thread once done. :pray:
